Our record is shown as it is filed: anonymized, graded by evidence and labelled by status.

These 19 engagements are a selection from HAYKALAH’s record, drawn from an archive census of 650+ engagements, 2004–2026. Each case shows the year, the place, HAYKALAH’s role, the status as recorded and the evidence grade, and is tagged with the ways we created value. Filter by sector, role, city, status, year or how we create value.

How to read this record

  • Evidence A: a signed agreement, or an outcome recorded in a primary document.

  • Evidence B: HAYKALAH work product on file, such as a study, model, memorandum or draft agreement.

  • Outcomes are “recorded in HAYKALAH files” until they are corroborated with the client.

  • Designed capacity (pilgrims, rooms, areas) is what a project was designed for, not a recorded outcome.

  • Where documents give different values, the range is shown, or no figure.

  • “Scope delivered” means HAYKALAH completed its part of the work, not that the project was built.

  • Proposals and frameworks are not mandates.

  • Work from the founder’s career before HAYKALAH is not included.

All figures indicative. Project value = size of the client project as recorded, not capital raised by HAYKALAH. Clients are anonymized until they consent in writing. Shariah structures are subject to Shariah board approval. Issuing and dealing in securities, including tokens, are regulated activities executed through appropriately licensed partners.

    Saudi-German localization engine

    Place
    Saudi Arabia, city not specified · Germany
    Client
    A German localization partner
    HAYKALAH role
    Co-founder of each Saudi entity
    Status
    Final draft; signing not yet recorded
    Practice

    German companies would enter the Kingdom through Saudi entities that HAYKALAH co-founds with a German localization partner. A partner pool of 25% of each entity vests 20% at registration, 30% at the first revenue contract and 50% at an agreed KPI threshold. The agreement is a final draft, and signing is not yet recorded.

  2. 2026Evidence B: work product on file

    Stadium precinct Sukuk framework (proposal)

    Place
    Saudi Arabia, city not specified
    Client
    A public stadium program (not named)
    HAYKALAH role
    Concept originator
    Status
    Proposal; no mandate
    Practice

    HAYKALAH proposed a Sukuk framework for stadium precincts: Musataha rights over the land, Istisna’a during construction, then Ijara or Wakala-Ijara, with one issuer per stadium across seven precincts for 2034. It is a proposal with no mandate, and figures are withheld until the source documents are reconciled. Shariah structures are subject to Shariah board approval.

    Waqf structuring and a waqf-manager model

    Place
    Saudi Arabia, city not specified
    Client
    Waqf founders, including a Saudi family
    HAYKALAH role
    Structurer and financial modeler; waqf-manager model
    Status
    Proposed and modeled; no outcome recorded
    Practice

    Since 2010 HAYKALAH has structured waqfs and codified the work into a waqf-manager model: establishing the waqf, governing it through a nazir and distributing its income. Shariah structures are subject to Shariah board approval.
